tools.name: detect_upcoming_missions
tools.description: Step 1 in Artefact Target EOM Process: Queries BigQuery (mart_ext_eom_chat_missions) to detect active client missions ending at J-7 or target date.

daysAhead.description: Number of days ahead to scan (default 7 for J-7 kickoff)

targetDate.description: Optional specific end date formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD'

clientName.description: Optional substring filter for client name (e.g. Crédit Agricole, Clariane)

leadEmail.description: Optional filter for a specific mission lead email

limit.description: Max number of records to retrieve (default 50)

tools.name: detect_and_launch_missions
tools.description: Autonomous Pipeline Orchestrator: Chains Step 1 (BigQuery Detection) into Step 2 (Kickoff Launch). Scans BigQuery for missions ending at J-7, checks Central Status Tracker for existing entries, and automatically launches new missions.

autoLaunch.description: If True, launches detected missions; if False, returns preview candidates

dryRun.description: If True, simulates launch without creating Google Drive files or sending emails

overrideLeadEmail.description: Optional email to redirect kickoff notifications during testing

limit.description: Max number of missions to process

tools.name: launch_mission_kickoff
tools.description: Initializes mission workspace folder, 3-section Debrief Google Doc (Challenge, Solution, Results), Visuals subfolder, dispatches kickoff email to lead and team, and registers status LAUNCHED in tracker.

missionName.description: Name of the mission (e.g. Clariane, TotalEnergies)

leadEmail.description: Email address of the mission delivery lead

teamEmails.description: List of project team member emails to notify (CC)

folderId.description: Optional existing Google Drive mission folder ID

parentFolderId.description: Optional Google Drive parent folder ID

tools.name: check_mission_debrief_status
tools.description: Step 3: Inspects a mission Google Doc or folder to verify debrief completion (Challenge, Solution, Results) and detect placeholder removal.

docId.description: Google Doc ID, Drive folder ID, or full URL

tools.name: send_mission_reminder
tools.description: Step 3: Dispatches an automated reminder email (J-3 or J-1) to the mission lead if the debrief Google Doc is incomplete, and logs milestone in the tracker.

leadEmail.description: Email address of the mission delivery lead

folderId.description: Optional Google Drive mission folder ID

overrideLeadEmail.description: Optional email to redirect notification during testing

dryRun.description: If True, simulates reminder without sending email

tools.name: trigger_eom_reminders
tools.description: Step 3: Autonomous Batch Reminder Engine. Scans Central Status Tracker for active missions (LAUNCHED, REMINDER_J3), inspects debrief doc completion, and dispatches J-3 / J-1 reminders.

daysAhead.description: Optional specific day horizon to trigger (e.g. 3 for J-3, 1 for J-1)

forceSend.description: If True, triggers reminder dispatch for active missions regardless of date

dryRun.description: If True, simulates scan and reminder preview without sending emails

overrideLeadEmail.description: Optional email to redirect notifications during testing

limit.description: Max number of missions to process

tools.name: extract_folder_documents
tools.description: Extracts document contents, file metadata, and mission context from a Google Drive mission folder.

folderId.description: Google Drive folder URL or 33-character folder ID

tools.name: generate_one_pager_slide
tools.description: Generates a Google Slides executive summary card using the Artefact EOM master template.

folderId.description: Google Drive folder URL or ID to save the presentation in

cardData.description: Dictionary of synthesized debrief fields: Context, Objectives, Deliverables, Team, Key Results, Learnings

templateId.description: Template presentation ID to copy from

tools.name: create_audit_sheet
tools.description: Creates a Google Sheets audit checklist tracking confidentiality, risk level, and sanitization flags for mission deliverables.

folderId.description: Google Drive folder URL or ID to save the audit sheet in

auditRecords.description: List of file audit records with classification, risk_level, and recommendations

tools.name: send_lead_notification
tools.description: Sends an email notification via Gmail to the Mission Lead containing links to the generated Slide and Sheet.

recipientEmail.description: Email address of the Mission Lead

slideUrl.description: Link to the generated Google Slides deck

sheetUrl.description: Link to the generated Google Sheets audit checklist

tools.name: log_pipeline_status
tools.description: Upserts the project lifecycle status and artifact links into the Central Pipeline Status Tracker spreadsheet.

status.description: Pipeline milestone status (e.g. LAUNCHED, DOCS_EXTRACTED, DECK_GENERATED, AUDIT_READY, NOTIFIED_LEAD)

risk.description: Highest detected confidentiality risk (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL)
